metaTitle: Wedding Dessert Cups: Sizes, Flavour Mixes, Timing
metaDescription: Wedding dessert cups, hand-layered in Hamilton. Plan the dessert table or the dessert course: the 96, colour-led mixes, allergens and Saturday delivery.
h1: Wedding dessert cups for the dessert table, or as the course itself
intro: Your wedding dessert table should feel as considered as the rest of the day. Dessert Shot by Farhana hand-layers dessert cups and mini dessert shots in Hamilton, made fresh the morning of pickup or delivery. For a wedding, it comes down to three calls: which size does the job, how to split a 96 across flavours and colours, and how to time it all around the 96's 7-day minimum notice and Saturday delivery.

sections.heading: The 96: the wedding pack
sections.body:
For a wedding-sized guest list, start with the 96. It comes with:

- Up to 16 flavours, more than the eight on the menu, so the flavour limit won't hold you back. The real choice is how many of each: at least 6 cups per flavour, in multiples of 6.
- A custom label option. Ask about it when you send your request.
- Event-day pickup.

A presentation tray isn't part of the pack; one is available on request, at an extra cost. The 96 arrives as four boxes of 24 cups, with no lids, and it needs at least 7 days' notice.

What a 96 costs:

- Mini Shots (2 oz): $168 all Classic, $215 all Premium
- Dessert Cups (5 oz): $379 all Classic, $499 all Premium

Classic and Premium flavours mix freely in the same pack. A mixed pack is priced cup by cup at each flavour's tier, so the total lands between those two figures. Per cup, that's $1.75 to about $2.24 for a Mini Shot and about $3.95 to $5.20 for a Dessert Cup. [Compare every pack and size](/packages).

Planning something smaller, like a rehearsal dinner or an intimate wedding? The 48 is our most popular pack: up to 8 flavours and priority preparation. [Start a 48 instead](/order?pack=48&event=wedding).

sections.heading: Mini Shots or Dessert Cups: tasting table or dessert course
sections.body:
Two sizes, two different jobs.

Mini Shots are 2 oz, a tasting size. They belong on a dessert table beside the cake, where guests come back for a second flavour, then a third.

Dessert Cups are 5 oz, a full serving. They can be the dessert course itself, set at each place or passed around after dinner, with no queue at the cake. Cups so good people stop talking when they hit the spoon, which at a wedding may be the only quiet minute between speeches.

A starting point, not a rule:

- Cups as the dessert course: about one Dessert Cup per guest. Around 90 guests fits one 96 of Dessert Cups, with a few to spare.
- Mini Shots next to a cake: about two per guest. Around 45 guests fits one 96 of Mini Shots.
- More guests than that: order more than one pack. There's no maximum, as long as each pack meets the minimums. The form takes one pack at a time, so mention the others in your notes or send another request.

Want both, with Mini Shots on the table and Dessert Cups for the course? That's two packs, which is fine. The order form takes one size per request, so start with one and add the other to your notes, or send a second request.

[Start a 96 of Mini Shots](/order?pack=96&size=2oz&event=wedding) or [start a 96 of Dessert Cups](/order?pack=96&size=5oz&event=wedding).

sections.heading: Mixing flavours for a wedding dessert table
sections.body:
The rules fit on a place card:

- At least 6 cups per flavour, in multiples of 6 (6, 12, 18 and so on).
- Up to 16 flavours in a 96, 8 in a 48, 4 in a 24.
- Classic and Premium mix freely in the same pack.

Three ways to split a 96:

- Seven across: 18 Dubai Chocolate, 18 Strawberry Fields and 12 each of Mango Dream, Blueberry Haze, Kinder Bueno, Ferrero Royale and Biscoff Bliss. A natural fit for Mini Shots, where the fun is tasting your way across the table. Tiramisu is left out because it comes as a Dessert Cup only; in a 96 of Dessert Cups it can be an eighth flavour.
- Four deep: 24 each of Strawberry Fields, Mango Dream, Biscoff Bliss and Dubai Chocolate. Fewer choices, fuller rows.
- Lighter on tree nuts: 24 Dubai Chocolate, 12 Ferrero Royale, 24 Strawberry Fields, 18 Mango Dream and 18 Biscoff Bliss. That's 36 cups from two flavours flagged for tree nuts and 60 from three that aren't.

See each flavour's layers and allergens on the [menu](/menu).

sections.heading: Choosing flavours by your wedding colours
sections.body:
Each flavour brings its own colours, so your mix can follow your palette. Four wedding palettes to start from:

- Green and gold: [Dubai Chocolate](/menu/dubai-chocolate) with [Biscoff Bliss](/menu/biscoff-bliss). Some Dubai Chocolate cups are topped with rose petals.
- Blush and lilac: [Strawberry Fields](/menu/strawberry-fields) with [Blueberry Haze](/menu/blueberry-haze).
- Evening, in deep chocolate: [Ferrero Royale](/menu/ferrero-royale) with [Kinder Bueno](/menu/kinder-bueno).
- Garden, in sunny tones: [Mango Dream](/menu/mango-dream) with [Strawberry Fields](/menu/strawberry-fields).

Every flavour's colours are in our [colour guide](/events).

On the table, give each flavour its own row so the layers line up, and run the rows in your palette's order. Choose by colour first, then check the allergen notes below. To see the cups up close, browse our Instagram, @dessertshot.ca.

sections.heading: Timing: 7 days' notice for a 96, and Saturday delivery
sections.body:
A 96 needs at least 7 days' notice, and we can't take one on shorter notice. For a wedding, treat that week as a floor, not a plan. A smaller pack, like a 48 for the rehearsal dinner, needs 48 hours' notice; under 48 hours counts as urgent, subject to availability, with a rush fee.

How the run-up works:

- Once your guest count and menu are settled: choose the size, the pack and your mix.
- By 9 AM, 7 days before you need the cups: send your request for the 96. For Saturday delivery, that means 9 AM the Saturday before at the latest, and for a wedding, much earlier.
- Within the day: we confirm by email, text or Instagram, with your total and how to pay the deposit.
- The morning of pickup or delivery: your cups are made fresh.

Getting the cups to the celebration:

- Delivery: on Saturdays, to Hamilton, Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga and Toronto. Add the address to your request, and if you need the cups by a set time, ask for it in your notes. Someone needs to be there to receive them. The delivery fee is quoted as part of your total when we confirm. More on [delivery outside Hamilton](/dessert-cups-gta).
- Pickup: free in Hamilton, by arrangement. Once the order is confirmed, we share the location with the person who placed it, and a friend, colleague or courier can collect. The 96 includes event-day pickup. More on [pickup in Hamilton](/dessert-cups-hamilton).

One practical tip: give the pickup job to someone who isn't getting married that day. Once the cups arrive, keep them refrigerated until the dessert table goes out; they can sit out for about 2 hours.

sections.heading: Allergen planning for a big, mixed guest list
sections.body:
Wedding guest lists are wide, so sort out the table before guests start asking.

- Set the three flavours flagged for tree nuts, Kinder Bueno, Ferrero Royale and Dubai Chocolate, together at one end. It's a convenience that helps guests find them, not allergy protection; the allergen notice at the bottom of this page still applies.
- Put a card by each flavour with its name and allergens ([more on planning the table in the FAQ](/faq)).

{{dietaryClaim}} If a guest follows a strict medical diet, message us before you order. Each flavour's allergens are on the [menu](/menu).

sections.heading: What happens after you send your request
sections.body:
1. You send it: size, pack, flavour counts and the wedding date, then pickup or delivery (with the address if you want Saturday delivery). Ask about the custom label in your request. The form shows the price of your cups.
2. We confirm within the day by email, text or Instagram. If you chose delivery, the fee is part of the total we send.
3. You pay the deposit, which confirms your order. We explain how to pay it when we confirm. [What happens next](/faq).

Planning the shower as well? See [bridal shower dessert cups](/events/bridal-showers).

faqs.q: Can we have one flavour for all 96 cups?
faqs.a: Yes, the order rules allow it. Each flavour needs at least 6 cups, in multiples of 6, so one flavour can fill the whole 96. An all-Classic or all-Premium 96 costs exactly the listed price on the [packages](/packages) page.

faqs.q: Our wedding isn't on a Saturday. What are our options?
faqs.a: Delivery runs on Saturdays only, to Hamilton, Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga and Toronto. For any other day, ask about pickup in Hamilton when you send your request. It's free, by arrangement, and your cups are made the morning of pickup. We share the pickup location with the person who ordered once the order is confirmed, and a friend or courier can collect for you.

faqs.q: Can we leave the tree-nut flavours out entirely?
faqs.a: Yes. Kinder Bueno, Ferrero Royale and Dubai Chocolate are the flavours flagged for tree nuts, so build your mix from the flavours that aren't. That keeps those three off your table, but not out of the kitchen: every cup is made in the same kitchen, so cross-contact is possible, and leaving them out doesn't make the table safe for a nut allergy. If a guest has one, message us before you order.
